entry.source: 1) Select the device your wish to configure from the drop-down.
entry.target: 1) 从下拉列表中选择要配置的设备。

entry.source: 2) Identify the control you wish to configure by moving the joystick or pressing the button. The result is shown in the Input column.
entry.target: 2) 通过移动操纵杆或按下按键来识别要配置的控制，结果显示在“输入”列。

entry.source: 3) Using the drop-down or dialog button, select what you want the control to do. "Custom" indicates a manually configured command.
entry.target: 3) 使用下拉列表或对话框按钮，选择该控制的功能。“自定义”表示手动配置的命令。

entry.source: Your selection will take effect immediately.
